[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of Captain Muscles (Nathan Harbour)s mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2385755478 based on the continued version https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2882473192 by Khobs
- No longer needs Harmony

[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [img]https://img.litet.net/Mi8ecQv.gif[/img] It's time to party! But wait, your colonists didn't get the memo... This mod fixes that.
[h2]Instructions[/h2] [hr][/hr] 1. Select a colonist 2. Right-click a party spot 3. ??? 4. Party your f****** ass off!
The forced party can ignore certain conditions that would normally prevent a party from starting, such as bad temperature, danger, etc. So beware and/or enjoy!
[hr][/hr] Github download link: [url=https://github.com/CaptainMuscles/CM_Party_Your_Ass_Off/releases]https://github.com/CaptainMuscles/CM_Party_Your_Ass_Off/releases[/url]
